latest.title: Instantaneous shrinking of supports for stochastic PDEs
latest.abstract: We study instantaneous shrinking of supports for nonnegative solutions of the stochastic partial differential equation \[ \partial_t u=a(t,x)\,\partial_x^2 u + b(t,x)\,\partial_x u + c(t,x)\,u +σ(u)\,ξ(t,x), \qquad (t,x)\in(0,\infty)\times\mathbb R, \] where $ξ$ is space-time white noise, the coefficients $a$, $b$, $c$ may be random, and the noise coefficient $σ$ vanishes at the origin and is sublinear there. The model case is $σ(u)=u^γ$ with $γ\in(0,1)$. We show that, under a uniqueness-in-law assumption, if the initial datum has a sufficiently light spatial tail, then every nonnegative solution has compact support at every positive time, even though the initial support is not compact. The initial datum may also be a measure, such as a Dirac mass. When $γ\in(0,1/2]$, finite initial mass suffices; this covers the super-Brownian case $γ=1/2$. When $γ\in(1/2,1)$, we identify a polynomial moment condition on the initial state whose order diverges as $γ\uparrow1$, quantifying the trade-off between the strength of the noise near zero and the decay of the initial data required for instantaneous shrinking. As a step of independent interest, we establish weak existence of solutions started from measure-valued initial data for non-Lipschitz $σ$ and random operators. Our results provide a stochastic counterpart of the instantaneous shrinking phenomenon of Evans and Knerr for deterministic parabolic equations with strong absorption, in which the role of the absorption term is played entirely by the noise.
latest.workSummary: 研究带次线性噪声系数的随机抛物方程支持集瞬时收缩。证明初始数据即使非紧支撑，只要尾部足够轻，正时间解几乎处处具有紧支撑；并处理测度值初值和随机算子下的弱存在。
latest.breakthrough: 将确定性强吸收方程的瞬时支持收缩现象转化为噪声在零点次线性退化所产生的效应，并量化了噪声指数与初始矩条件之间的阈值关系。
latest.limitations: 依赖唯一性（law）假设和文中系数正则性；紧支撑结论不覆盖线性噪声或任意重尾初始数据。

steps.claim: 正则初值的解满足支持集瞬时收缩所需的尾部概率估计。
steps.route: 把初始函数拆成紧支撑部分与尾部，使用时间 cutoff 和随机抛物估计分别控制紧支撑解与尾部解；次线性噪声的零点退化使尾部贡献按时间快速衰减。
steps.evidence: 第 5 节 Theorem 2.6、Proposition 6.4（PDF 第 16--28 页）。

steps.claim: 当噪声指数不超过二分之一时，有限初始质量足以推出任意正时间的紧支撑。
steps.route: 将局部核的空间尾积分与初始总质量结合，选择足够高的 cutoff 阈值，使远场事件概率可求和；Borel--Cantelli 与非负性把概率尾界升级为几乎处处的有限支持半径。
steps.evidence: 第 2 节 Theorem 2.6、相关矩条件（PDF 第 6--9 页）。

steps.claim: 测度值初值下存在弱解，并且满足紧支撑性质。
steps.route: 先用平滑密度和时间正则化近似测度初值，利用统一矩估计提取 Skorokhod 表示下的弱收敛；唯一性定律识别极限，尾部估计在极限中保持。
steps.evidence: 第 6 节 Proposition 6.4、Theorem 2.10 及证明（PDF 第 9、31--45 页）。

steps.claim: 当噪声指数大于二分之一时，支持收缩需要精确的多项式初始矩条件，且该阶随指数趋一而发散。
steps.route: 在局部化估计中计算噪声幂次产生的尾积分，令初始矩阶覆盖该指数依赖的阈值；将每个时间层的半径控制迭代，得到瞬时紧支持与阈值的定量关系。
steps.evidence: 第 2 节 Theorem 2.10/Remark 2.11 与第 7 节 Proposition 7.1（PDF 第 9、45--49 页）。

latest.priorityReason: 论文聚焦椭圆与抛物方程，主要进展属于存在性；排序综合考虑其与 PDE 机制、可复用估计、正则性和长时间行为的相关程度。
